title: Iran Foreign Ministry Steps In to Locate Fishermen Missing at Sea for One Week
text:
Iran Foreign Ministry Steps In to Locate Fishermen Missing at Sea for One Week"

""
"The head of the Iranian Foreign Ministry’s representative office in Hormozgan province has announced that efforts are actively underway to determine the fate of local fishermen from the port city of Bandar Lengeh who have been missing at sea for the past seven days. "

"The official confirmed that investigating the case and gathering information on the current status of the missing crew members is a top priority for the office. Hormozgan province, located along the strategic Strait of Hormuz and the Persian Gulf, frequently sees fishermen operating in waters that can sometimes cross into neighboring countries' maritime zones, which often prompts the Foreign Ministry to coordinate search efforts with regional authorities.
